name: mq-antilles-goods-movements
description: Martinique goods-movement reference for businesses dispatching or receiving goods within the Guadeloupe–Martinique single fiscal territory. Explains the distinction between ordinary cleared goods and suspensive regimes, accompanying evidence, the monthly dispatch declaration and its working-day deadline. Separates sold goods, own-stock movements and temporary movements, and identifies the records needed to reconcile dispatches. This narrow Guide uses the official July 2025 customs circular rather than assuming that no new customs clearance means no reporting. Product taxation, special excise controls, Guyane trade and complete territory coverage require separate work and independent review.
